title: Development of an IoT System for Monitoring the Operation of a Biogas Plant
content: It is well known that the quality of biogas directly affects its energy value and efficiency of use in power plants, as well as determines the profitability of production. However, it can be difficult to identify deviations in the quality of biogas at early stages, especially in industrial conditions, as this requires in-depth knowledge of the physico-chemical characteristics of the gas. As part of this project, an intelligent biogas quality management system was developed using Internet of Things technologies designed to monitor key parameters such as temperature, methane levels and gas humidity. The ESP32 microcontroller, programmed in C, was used as the control module, which collected data from sensors and transferred them to cloud storage. A web application has also been created that provides the user with the ability to remotely monitor and control the system in real time from any device connected to the Internet. Notifications and alarms could be transmitted via WhatsApp messenger. The system has demonstrated high efficiency in increasing the stability and productivity of biogas production.
